title: Parental addition from the child allowance ("doubling")

source.title: National Insurance Institute, child savings: parental addition (doubling) page

monthly_addition.notes: Optional parental addition taken from the child allowance, NIS 58 a month in 2026 (NIS 57 in 2025), so NIS 116 a month goes in with the basic deposit. The rule states the figure but the requester named no figure for CS-04; the name monthly_addition is this file's own choice. The amount is fixed by a Finance Minister order (s.74ב(א)(3)); NII pages give only NIS 58.
